round: Review A remediation F21: jsdom cascade for contrast
green_command: CI=true pnpm --filter www-reading-advantage exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=dot
note: All four gates exited 0 through heavy-run. The two new cascade unit cases raise the count from 1394 to 1396. Line coverage is 91.83 percent, above the 85.52 floor and the 86.52 baseline. The class-token background reader is gone. real-css.ts exports the compiled stylesheet and a version with @layer wrappers removed and @property rules dropped, because jsdom ignores layered rules and cannot parse @property descriptors. contrast.ts injects that stylesheet once into the test document and reads color and background-color with window.getComputedStyle, so jsdom applies class, type, id and descendant selectors. Recursive composition is unchanged: opaque stops, translucent composes over the parent backdrop, transparent is skipped, background images and unreadable values throw, and unresolved foreground throws. Both new unit cases pass: a type-selector body background plus a descendant-selector translucent layer compose to the hand-computed backdrop and ratio, and a page whose only painted background is the body rule resolves to that color and not white. Both R2 contrast tests pass on the shipped pages. jsdom logs cosmetic parse warnings for modern declarations it cannot model; the selectors and declarations these tests need are verified by the passing unit and page tests. Two production mutations each failed the target numeric contrast assertion with exit 1. Each production edit was restored and git status shows no production change. The commit header was shortened for the 100-character commitlint limit.
